summary.recommended_next_step: If 'truth_store' and 'decision_layer' are intended as new canonical architectural designations, the required sequencing per CLAUDE.md Section 11 is: (1) SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_AND_BUILD_SEQUENCE_v1.md must be updated first to introduce and authorize both terms with role-matched definitions — this is the mandatory unblocking step; (2) SYSTEM_TECHNICAL_HANDBOOK_v1.md; (3) SYSTEM_IMPLEMENTATION_RECORD_v1.md; (4) SYSTEM_LIMITATIONS_AND_APPROXIMATIONS_v1.md — must confirm no snapshot-boundary ambiguity is introduced; (5) DOCUMENTATION_VERIFICATION_MATRIX_v1.md; (6) README_v1.md; (7) README_LAYER2.md; (8) CLAUDE.md. No rename of any document, code path, or canonical reference may proceed until Step 1 produces a compliant role-citation verdict with explicit phase-gate label mapping. Phase B implementation work (snapshot consumer, DecisionPacket skeleton, etc.) is unblocked independently and may proceed under the existing 'Layer 2' / 'Layer 3' terminology without waiting for this terminology change.
